item.title: Bilstein 33-245492 Toyota Hilux 4WD Rear B8 5100 Shock Absorber
item.body_html:
Bilstein 33-245492 B8 5100 rear shock absorber for selected 2005-2015 Toyota Hilux 4WD applications with 0-1 inch rear lift. Confirm the exact vehicle and suspension setup before ordering.

  • Sold as one shock absorber. Two are required for the rear axle.
  • Non-adjustable monotube damper with a 46 mm piston, zinc-plated body and black bellows.
  • Upper and lower mount type: 19 mm eye.
  • This is a shock absorber, not a lift kit or complete spring assembly. No spring seat is included.
  • Installation must be carried out by a qualified suspension specialist with suitable tools and safe vehicle support.

Confirm the manufacturer part number, chassis, build year, drivetrain, lift height and mounting details before ordering. A model and year label alone is not fitment confirmation.
